label: THE_FADE_PHASE2_T74_AMEND_MVP_APPROVAL_SCOPE_TO_SCOPED_MVP_PATH
canonical_file_role: Single machine-readable Phase 2 MVP approval-scope decision on disk. T73 (Prompt #325) previously locked all-lanes-required + full six-dimension closure; T74 (Prompt #326) supersedes that policy shape only inside this file — not a second decision file.

current_approval_truth.note: Mirrors binding mvp_lane_approval.json after T80 (Prompt #336) and Prompt #337 repair: approved:true, approved_mvp_lanes as listed, deferred_lanes []. Scoped MVP approval per t80_scoped_mvp_approval_decision.json (YES); not Phase 3 readiness.

approval_scope_policy.eligibility_rule_single_reading: A future approval flip (editing mvp_lane_approval.json to set approved:true and/or to make approved_mvp_lanes non-empty) becomes ELIGIBLE only if ALL of the following are true at flip time: (1) lane_b_official_disclosure satisfies primary_lane_rule in this file; (2) at least TWO distinct lanes from support_lane_pool satisfy support_lane_rule in this file; (3) a later governed approval-decision tranche documents explicit operator signoff on disk (governed prompt + aligned control docs). If any condition fails, the flip is not eligible under this scoped MVP path.

requirements: In mvp_lane_evidence_registry.json at flip time, lane_b_official_disclosure must have no dimension_evidence_status value equal to not_started for any of the six MVP dimensions.

For every MVP dimension, Lane B must have either (a) on-disk evidence that satisfies the operator at the Phase 2 MVP source-reliability audit bar for that dimension, or (b) an explicit operator-accepted governance treatment on disk (charter clause, decision JSON, or evidence log entry) that names the residual gap and accepts it for this scoped MVP path.
Lane B must be the lane the operator explicitly treats as the primary disclosure anchor in the approval-decision tranche — not merely the historically deepest or most interesting lane.

as_of_t74_on_disk_assessment.honest_reason_not_met: All six dimensions remain partial in the registry; residual gaps are not closed at full gate bar and there is no on-disk operator-accepted governance treatment that formally accepts each residual gap for scoped MVP approval. Therefore primary_lane_rule is NOT satisfied as of T74.

primary_lane_rule.as_of_t74_historical_note: This block is a frozen snapshot as of Tranche 74 only. For any flip-time or post-T80 eligibility reading, use as_of_t80_on_disk_assessment only. Do not treat as_of_t74_on_disk_assessment as current truth after T76/T78 governance acceptance packs and T80 approval decision.

as_of_t80_on_disk_assessment.conjunct_1_rationale: lane_b_official_disclosure has no not_started dimensions in mvp_lane_evidence_registry.json. Per-dimension (a)|(b) satisfied: explicit scoped MVP governance (b) for all six MVP dimensions via lane_b_t76_scoped_mvp_governance_acceptance_pack.json (four dimensions) plus lane_b_t78_scoped_mvp_governance_acceptance_pack.json (reliability, stale_outage_behavior). Registry dimension_evidence_status remains partial; (b) does not require closure at production bar.
as_of_t80_on_disk_assessment.conjunct_2_rationale: At least two of three support lanes meet support_lane_rule: lane_a_public_signal (T65 live slice + T66 slice-1 STOP + partial), lane_c_market_context (T67 + T68 + partial), lane_e_research_swarm_context (T70 honest scout_failure + T71 + partial). Minimum two satisfied; all three in fact qualify.
as_of_t80_on_disk_assessment.non_claims: This assessment does not assert Phase 3 readiness, production maturity, or full six-dimension closure on support lanes.

counts_toward_eligibility_only_if_all_tr: Exactly one bounded live observe-or-honest-failure HTTPS slice has executed for that lane against a charter-locked or log-locked source URL (normalized_signal_event or scout_failure both count as honest slice outcomes).
mvp_lane_evidence_registry.json shows evidence_status at least partial for that lane.
An explicit slice stop, default freeze for new live evidence, or stop-for-now lock for that lane exists on disk (e.g., charter stop clause or equivalent governance doc).
Six-dimension full closure for that support lane is NOT required for this scoped MVP path — slice-1 minimum only.
support_lane_rule.explicit_non_claim: Satisfying support_lane_rule does not assert that the support lane is mature on all MVP dimensions; it only satisfies the slice-1 minimum for counting toward the two-of-three support-lane requirement.

dimension_policy.scoped_mvp_approval_eligibility_meaning: Primary lane (lane_b_official_disclosure) must satisfy primary_lane_rule (strict bar: no not_started; every dimension closed at bar or explicitly accepted on disk). Each lane counted toward the two support lanes must satisfy support_lane_rule (bounded live slice + partial + stop/freeze lock) only. Full six-dimension closure across all four deferred lanes is NOT required for approval eligibility under this amended scope. This is not a claim that every deferred lane is production-mature.

lane_posture_policy.t74_note: T74 does not reopen any lane; posture unchanged from T71-era stops and Lane B default freeze.

deferred_from_scoped_mvp_path: Full six-dimension MVP closure on all support lanes (A/C/E)
Phase 3 universe scanner, runtime, dashboard, and production integration
not_sufficient_for_approval: Another random evidence slice without a new explicit charter for that lane
Support-lane activity or slice history without primary_lane_rule satisfaction for Lane B
Silent or verbal-only operator acceptance not written into on-disk governance (charter, decision file, evidence log, or checklist)
Strong Lane B slices alone while primary_lane_rule remains unsatisfied

allowed_next_tranche_classes: Exactly one new explicit Lane B charter tranche naming one sharply bounded objective tied to satisfying primary_lane_rule (authoring and/or bounded execution only as that charter permits)
Exactly one approval-decision tranche only if scoped-MVP eligibility per this file is already satisfied on disk and the governed prompt contains explicit operator signoff
Exactly one governance hold tranche (doc-only pause; no collection)

Exactly one bounded Phase 3 entry planning only tranche as defined in phase3_entry_planning_only_definition (post-T82; docs and/or one machine-readable planning/governance artifact only; no implementation)
forbidden_next_without_new_governance: New live evidence on lanes A/C/E by default (charter-first; no ad-hoc observe passes)
Multi-lane simultaneous reopen or multi-lane live collection
Phase 3 implementation (universe scanner, runtime, dashboard, or production integration in executable form)
Scanner, runtime, or dashboard coding or wiring toward production under THE FADE Phase 3
Provider integration for MVP lanes (concrete provider wiring, credentials, live adapters) without a later explicit implementation governance tranche
Lane reopen for new live evidence without a new explicit charter for that lane
Evidence collection tranches (new observes, new slices, new audits) framed as Phase 3 entry planning
mvp_lane_approval.json approval flip without satisfying approval_scope_policy and primary_lane_rule and support_lane_rule as written in this amended file
Second concurrent Lane B charter or overlapping bounded objectives without a new tranche that explicitly rescopes
next_tranche_authorization_rule.t82_note: Tranche 82 (Prompt #342) splits pre-T80 combined ban on Phase 3 work: Phase 3 entry planning only is now an explicit allowed_next class; Phase 3 implementation and coding remain forbidden until a later explicit governance step.

phase3_entry_planning_only_definition.tranche_lock_reference: T82 Prompt #342 post-T80 Phase 3 entry governance lock
phase3_entry_planning_only_definition.single_meaning: After T82, one future governed tranche may perform Phase 3 entry planning only as defined here. This does not authorize Phase 3 implementation.
permitted_in_planning_tranche_only: Markdown or text control docs under future_modules/the_fade/docs/ and/or future_modules/stock_module/ canon checklists, scoped by the governed prompt
At most one new narrow machine-readable JSON under future_modules/the_fade/config/ if the governed prompt explicitly authorizes it (scope statement, milestones, non-executable boundaries only)
Updates to existing governance JSON listed in the governed prompt (e.g. this file) only as explicitly scoped
explicitly_forbidden_inside_planning_tra: Production or development runtime code (scanner, worker, scheduler, dashboard UI/backend)
Executable scripts added or changed for Phase 3 execution paths (observation collectors, live pipelines)
Provider integration: API clients, secrets, deployment config, or wiring mvp_lane_approval.json provider placeholders into live systems
Lane reopen: new live HTTPS observes, new charter-less collection, or relaxing lane_posture_policy stops
Evidence collection: new Phase 2 evidence slices, new audit executions, or registry dimension_evidence_status rewrites under the guise of planning
phase3_entry_planning_only_definition.non_claims: Phase 3 entry planning only does not assert production readiness, does not clear registry partialities, does not unlock support-lane live work, and does not substitute for a future explicit Phase 3 implementation governance tranche.

post_t82_on_disk_governance_lock.label: THE_FADE_PHASE2_T82_POST_T80_PHASE3_ENTRY_GOVERNANCE_LOCK
post_t82_on_disk_governance_lock.statement: Scoped MVP approval (T80) remains in force and is not production maturity. Lane posture unchanged: A/C/E stopped-for-now; Lane B frozen by default for new evidence without new charter. Registry partialities remain honest partial. This lock amends next_tranche_authorization_rule so Phase 3 entry planning only is explicitly allowed as one bounded next class; Phase 3 implementation, scanner/runtime/dashboard coding, provider integration, lane reopen, and evidence collection remain forbidden without future explicit governance.

post_t83_phase3_entry_planning_package.label: THE_FADE_PHASE3_ENTRY_T83_FOUNDATION_PLANNING_LOCK
post_t83_phase3_entry_planning_package.planning_note: Phase 3 entry planning package on disk: future_modules/the_fade/docs/THE_FADE_PHASE3_ENTRY_PLAN_T83.md and future_modules/the_fade/docs/THE_FADE_PHASE3_IMPLEMENTATION_BOUNDARY_T83.md. Defines Phase 3 entry as planning-only (no implementation, no provider wiring, no lane reopen, no evidence collection) and names exactly one candidate first implementation slice at planning level: static universe-scanner I/O contract artifacts only under future_modules/the_fade/ (no executable scan loop, network I/O, dashboard, provider integration, or registry/lane edits). Does not authorize Phase 3 implementation or production work. Scoped MVP approval (T80) remains binding; a later explicit Phase 3 implementation governance tranche is required before any executable Phase 3 code. This note is planning record only: it does not change status, current_approval_truth, approval_scope_policy, primary_lane_rule, support_lane_rule, dimension_policy, lane_posture_policy, or next_tranche_authorization_rule semantics beyond documenting that the T83 planning package exists.
post_t83_phase3_entry_planning_package.non_claims: T83 does not implement Phase 3, does not reopen lanes, does not authorize productionization, and does not substitute for a future implementation signoff tranche.

anti_drift_rule.statement: Pre-T80: No Phase 3 implementation before scoped MVP approval (T80) and explicit operator signoff on mvp_lane_approval.json per eligibility_rule_single_reading. Post-T80 and post-T82: Phase 3 implementation (scanner, runtime, dashboard, production integration, provider wiring) remains forbidden until a later explicit implementation governance tranche — not satisfied by Phase 3 entry planning only. One bounded Phase 3 entry planning only tranche is permitted per phase3_entry_planning_only_definition. This rule does not reintroduce all-lanes-required or full six-dimension closure across all four lanes.
